name: Colour-Blind Mode
author: byo-pop
description: Special tiles carry a symbol in their top-left corner, so they differ by shape as well as colour: a circle on green tiles, a square on gold, a rhombus on sapphire, a star on diamond and a triangle on fire tiles. Play is unchanged, so games keep the usual high scores.

settings.help: Bigger symbols, on a dark square.
